name: braces
description: Self-maintained fork of braces 3.0.3. GHSA-vfj7-8cjw-p6xm: stack exhaustion via deeply nested brace patterns, no fixed upstream release exists. Patch: depth guard (default maxDepth 250) on the expand/stringify/compile AST walkers, and utils.flatten rewritten iteratively. Version bumped to 3.0.4 only to mark the fork and satisfy ^3.0.3 ranges.
